summary: Old Chiangmai Cultural Center in Hai Ya offers a ticketed khantoke dinner with Lanna music and dance. A khantoke is a low round serving table for a shared Northern Thai meal; this venue presents that communal format as a scheduled visitor dinner show. It is distinct from an ordinary restaurant dinner, where a group orders dishes at its own pace without a performance program.
whyGo: Try a range of Northern Thai dishes and watch a sequence of regional music and dance in one planned evening.
The venue identifies itself as the originator of Chiang Mai's commercial khantoke dinner, first presented around 1970–71.
Classic, vegetarian and halal menu packages are listed, allowing some choice beyond the standard meat-and-seafood set.
bestFor: First-time visitors interested in a convenient introduction to Lanna food and performance.
Families and groups who enjoy shared dishes and a fixed dinner-show schedule.
Travelers who would like a vegetarian or halal set option and can confirm its preparation details in advance.
skipIf: You prefer a quiet, flexible restaurant meal or an in-depth, unscripted cultural encounter.
You need assured step-free access, wheelchair seating or accessible toilets; these details are not published clearly.
You have serious allergies or require strict cross-contact controls that the venue has not confirmed.
duration: Allow about 2 hours at the venue. The booking listing schedules arrival at 18:30, dinner at 18:35, performances from 19:10 and conclusion at 20:30; transport time is extra.
cost: The current booking listing shows ฿690 per adult for the Classic set, ฿740 for vegetarian or halal Classic sets, and higher-priced Heritage and Legacy packages. Drinks such as bottled water and cocktails are extra. These are current listed reference prices, not a December 2026 quote; confirm the exact package and price when reserving.
hours: The operator-linked Booking.page listing advertises dinner and show nightly, 18:30–20:30. The official contact page lists office hours but no dated December 2026 performance calendar. Check the exact date and arrival time with the venue before travelling.
bestTime: Choose an evening when you want dinner and a show together, and reserve ahead for December. Saturday evenings may require extra travel time because Wua Lai Road hosts the Saturday Walking Street and some sections close to cars.
gettingThere: Old Chiangmai Cultural Center is at 185/3 Wua Lai Road, Hai Ya, Chiang Mai 50100. The venue's contact page lists the RTC R3 (Yellow) bus stop outside; check the VIA BUS app or RTC channels for current service. Taxi or ride-hailing is convenient from the old city. The venue reports on-site parking for about 100 cars, though Saturday market closures may require parking at the perimeter and walking in.
booking: Use the venue's official reservation page or contact +66 95 145 0296 / reservation@oldchiangmai.com. Confirm the date, package, menu, seating, final price and any transfer inclusion. Its published cancellation terms offer a full deposit refund with at least 3 days' notice; shorter notice may receive a partial or no refund.
accessibility: The venue describes khantoke dining around a low table, but clear information about step-free routes, accessible toilets, wheelchair arrangements or chair-height seating was not found. Ask the venue directly about seating, access and mobility or hearing needs before paying.
practicalTips: The Classic menu listing includes hang lay curry, stir-fried vegetables, chicken with makwaen, pork chili dip, nam prik num, pork cracklings, rice, fruit and drinks such as tea or coffee. Menus can change; check the chosen package's current details.

The listed vegetarian set substitutes vegetable dishes and tofu; the halal set lists chicken dishes. Confirm ingredients, sauces, allergens and cross-contact directly, especially for strict dietary needs.

The standard Classic set is explicitly described as unsuitable for halal, vegetarian or vegan diets and as containing egg, fish, seafood and animal-based ingredients; choose a separately listed suitable package and verify it.
Keep the return ride flexible through the 20:30 finish, and allow extra time on Saturday evenings.
decemberNotes: No date-specific December 2026 show calendar or holiday exception was available in the sources checked. The operator-linked booking page currently advertises nightly shows, but reconfirm your exact date and current price before booking. December is a busy Chiang Mai travel period; allow extra road time, especially on Saturdays when the Wua Lai Walking Street affects vehicle access.
uncertainties: Nightly operation is the schedule currently advertised by the booking page; actual December 2026 availability and any holiday closures remain unconfirmed.
Current listed ticket prices may change before December 2026, and drink, transport and package inclusions should be checked for the selected date.
Step-free access, alternative chair seating, accessible toilets, and allergy or cross-contact practices are not established in the pages reviewed.
The linked photo is an Expedia Local Expert representative image of a khantoke dinner show; individual photographer attribution and reuse permission are not established.
